carpet.rule.illegalBlockCraft.name: Illegal block crafting (master switch)
carpet.rule.illegalBlockCraft.desc: When off, none of the recipes below can be crafted. When on, each rule below decides.
carpet.rule.craftCommandBlock.name: Craft command block (obsidian4+gold4+redstone block1)
carpet.rule.craftCommandBlock.desc: Yields 1 command block. Grid: O=obsidian, G=gold ingot, R=redstone block
carpet.rule.craftChainCommandBlock.name: Craft chain command block (obsidian4+amethyst4+redstone block1)
carpet.rule.craftChainCommandBlock.desc: Yields 1 chain command block. Grid: O=obsidian, A=amethyst shard, R=redstone block
carpet.rule.craftRepeatingCommandBlock.d: Yields 1 repeating command block. Grid: O=obsidian, Q=quartz, R=redstone block
carpet.rule.craftStructureBlock.name: Craft structure block (iron block4+diamond4+ender eye1)
carpet.rule.craftStructureBlock.desc: Yields 1 structure block. Grid: I=iron block, D=diamond, E=ender eye
carpet.rule.craftStructureVoid.name: Craft structure void (glass4+diamond1) -> 8
carpet.rule.craftStructureVoid.desc: Shapeless: 4 glass + 1 diamond yields 8 structure voids
carpet.rule.craftBarrier.name: Craft barrier (obsidian4+iron block4+diamond1) -> 4
carpet.rule.craftBarrier.desc: Yields 4 barriers. Grid: O=obsidian, I=iron block, D=diamond
carpet.rule.craftLightBlock.name: Craft light block (glowstone4+glass4+diamond1) -> 8
carpet.rule.craftLightBlock.desc: Yields 8 light blocks. Grid: G=glowstone, L=glass, D=diamond
carpet.rule.craftJigsaw.name: Craft jigsaw block (deepslate tiles4+ender pearl4+diamond1)
carpet.rule.craftJigsaw.desc: Yields 1 jigsaw block. Grid: T=deepslate tiles, P=ender pearl, D=diamond
carpet.rule.craftBedrock.name: Craft bedrock (obsidian8+netherite scrap1)
carpet.rule.craftBedrock.desc: Yields 1 bedrock. Grid: O=obsidian, N=netherite scrap
carpet.rule.craftSpawner.name: Craft spawner (iron block4+iron bars4+soul sand1)
carpet.rule.craftSpawner.desc: Yields 1 spawner. Grid: I=iron block, B=iron bars, S=soul sand
carpet.rule.craftEndPortalFrame.name: Craft end portal frame (end stone brick8+ender eye1)
carpet.rule.craftEndPortalFrame.desc: Yields 1 end portal frame. Grid: E=end stone brick, Y=ender eye
carpet.rule.craftReinforcedDeepslate.des: Yields 1 reinforced deepslate. Grid: D=deepslate, N=diamond
